sources.note: Nothing. Front matter sec. 4.1 (p.10, p. v): 'Fali of Baissa: Spoken by a few individuals on the Falinga Plateau in southern Taraba State. A fragmentary wordlist was recorded by Robert Koops in the early 1970s, suggesting that the language is clearly Benue-Congo, but its further affiliation is uncertain.' Index (p.29): 'Fali of Baissa – nearly extinct'; no head entry, no phonological data; listed under 'Unclassified Benue-Congo languages: Fali (in Baissa area; virtually extinct)'.
